name: Cloud-360 Azure WARA-aligned MVP Lens
description: Offline Custom Lens for Azure diagrams. Reliability questions are inspired by Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Reliability Assessment (WARA) themes—zones, redundancy, recovery targets, DR, and health/ops—adapted for architecture-diagram review (not a live WARA collector). Other pillars use Azure service vocabulary. References: https://github.com/Azure/Well-Architected-Reliability-Assessment and https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/well-architected/reliability/checklist

questions.title: How do you protect public ingress on Azure?
questions.description: Look for Application Gateway, Front Door, Azure Firewall, WAF, or Load Balancer at the edge.

choices.title: WAF / Front Door / Application Gateway is present

improvementPlan.displayText: Place Azure Front Door or Application Gateway with WAF in front of public entry points (aligns with edge protection expectations in Azure WAF reviews).
Terminate TLS at the edge (App Gateway / Front Door) and enforce HTTPS.

questions.title: How are secrets and data at rest protected?
questions.description: Look for Key Vault, encryption, private endpoints, or private networking on data stores.

improvementPlan.displayText: Use Azure Key Vault for keys/secrets and enable encryption on Storage / Azure SQL / Cosmos DB.

choices.title: Private Endpoint / private network for data is labeled

improvementPlan.displayText: Expose data planes via Private Endpoint or private VNet; avoid public data access.

questions.title: [WARA] How do you use Availability Zones for critical tiers?
questions.description: WARA / Azure WAF Reliability emphasizes zone redundancy. Look for multiple Availability Zones, zone-redundant services, or AZ labels.

improvementPlan.displayText: Deploy critical compute and data across at least two Availability Zones (WARA: resilience via zone redundancy).
Enable zone-redundant SKUs or replicas (e.g. Azure SQL zone-redundant, Cosmos multi-write) and label them on the diagram.

questions.title: [WARA] How do you plan disaster recovery / geo-failover?
questions.description: WARA recovery focus: paired regions, geo-replication, ASR, or explicit DR path on the diagram.

choices.title: Secondary region / geo-replica / paired region is labeled

improvementPlan.displayText: Add a secondary region or geo-replication path and document failover (aligns with WARA DR / recovery review).

choices.title: Backup / vault / recovery point is labeled

improvementPlan.displayText: Show Azure Backup, Recovery Services vault, or PITR and validate RPO on the diagram.

questions.title: [WARA] How does the workload detect faults and self-heal?
questions.description: Look for health probes, load-balancer probes, auto-heal, circuit breaker, or retry patterns labeled on the diagram.

choices.title: Health probe / health endpoint is labeled

improvementPlan.displayText: Add LB / App Gateway health probes and app health endpoints (WARA: detect and withstand faults).

choices.title: Auto-scale / auto-heal / restart policy is labeled

improvementPlan.displayText: Enable VMSS / AKS / App Service auto-heal or scale rules and show them on the diagram.

questions.title: How do you manage Azure storage tiers / lifecycle?
questions.description: Look for lifecycle management, Cool/Archive tiers, or reserved capacity labels.

improvementPlan.displayText: Add Blob lifecycle policies or reserved capacity where appropriate.

questions.title: How do you accelerate read-heavy paths on Azure?
questions.description: Look for Azure Cache for Redis, CDN, Front Door caching.

choices.title: Redis / CDN / Front Door cache is present

improvementPlan.displayText: Add Azure Cache for Redis and/or Azure CDN / Front Door caching for hot reads.

questions.title: How do you observe and alert the Azure workload?
questions.description: Look for Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Action Groups, alerts.

choices.title: Monitor / App Insights / Log Analytics is labeled

improvementPlan.displayText: Add Azure Monitor metrics/logs and Application Insights (WARA ops visibility).
Wire metric alerts to Action Groups for on-call notification.
